review_metadata.summary: Role correctly deploys Vaultwarden+Caddy with strong security controls (tailnet-IP-only binding, image pinning, secrets via sops). Idempotency solid. Minor gaps: missing task tags, handler lacks become context, docker-compose shell fallback, health-check error recovery unclear. Molecule scenario underdeveloped. Overall delivery-ready with refinements.

findings.issue: Admin password seeding script is generated but never executed. Script created at line 77-108 (seed-admin.sh) but no subsequent task invokes it.
findings.fix_recommendation: Add task after docker-compose up: 'ansible.builtin.command: /opt/vaultwarden/seed-admin.sh' with 'creates: /opt/vaultwarden/.admin-seeded' guard. Current design relies on env var in .env but initial admin password typically requires POST to /admin/register endpoint or similar in Vaultwarden.

findings.issue: Restart handler missing 'become_user: op' context. docker_compose_v2 module runs with 'become_user: op' in main task (line 118) but handler at line 3-12 has 'become: true' without 'become_user'.
findings.fix_recommendation: Add 'become_user: op' to both handlers (lines 3 and 14). Ensures handlers run under same user context as main tasks, critical for file ownership consistency.

findings.issue: Docker container inspection uses ansible.builtin.shell with 'docker ps' pipe to grep. Line 141-146 uses shell directly instead of docker module. Similarly, handler at handlers/main.yml:15 uses 'docker exec' in shell.
findings.fix_recommendation: Line 141-146: migrate to community.docker.docker_container_info with filters. Handler caddy reload: consider community.docker.docker_container or ansible.builtin.command if docker-cli is guaranteed present. Reduces shell injection risk and improves module consistency.

findings.issue: Variable naming inconsistent. Uses 'vaultwarden_*' prefix correctly, but templates reference 'tailscale_ip' (fact from base role) without declaring it as a requirement in defaults. Also 'caddy_log_level' lacks 'vaultwarden_' prefix.
findings.fix_recommendation: Add 'vaultwarden_caddy_log_level' variable to defaults (currently hardcoded in Caddyfile.j2:3). Document external dependency on 'tailscale_ip' in defaults as a comment. Ensures full role portability without implicit dependencies.

findings.dimension_name: Handler design — restart vs reload distinction
findings.issue: Caddy reload handler ignores errors ('|| true') but never logs the failure. If caddy reload fails, role silently continues. No feedback to operator about reload status.
findings.fix_recommendation: Change 'ignore_errors: true' to explicit error handling. Either: (a) fail loudly if caddy reload fails (safer for production), or (b) log warning and retry 3x with 1s delay before ignoring. Document choice in README.

findings.dimension_name: Templates — Jinja2 quality, escaping, injection safety
findings.issue: Environment variables in .env.j2 use unquoted template variables (lines 13, 19: ADMIN_TOKEN={{ vaultwarden_admin_token }}, VAULTWARDEN_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD={{...}}). If secret contains whitespace or special chars, will break env parsing.
findings.fix_recommendation: Quote all secret variables: ADMIN_TOKEN="{{ vaultwarden_admin_token | quote }}" and VAULTWARDEN_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD="{{ vaultwarden_initial_admin_password | quote }}". Use Jinja2 quote filter to escape shell/env special characters.

findings.dimension_name: Molecule scenario — converge + verify test coverage
findings.issue: Idempotence check (line 77-88) verifies 'ansible_play.status == completed' but does not assert 'changed_when: false' results from second run. Molecule test-sequence includes 'idempotence' step, but verify.yml re-runs role manually without capturing task-by-task change count.
findings.fix_recommendation: Let Molecule's built-in idempotence step (test_sequence line 44) handle the second run. Alternatively, capture task output and assert all 'changed_when: false' tasks from second run. Document why health-check tolerance is 60s (should match task timeout).

findings.dimension_name: README quality — sufficiency for next operator
findings.issue: README correctly documents sops integration and dependencies, but missing: (a) troubleshooting for health-check timeout failure modes (what if containers are stuck?), (b) no mention of how to manually seed admin password post-deploy, (c) internal-CA TLS assumption not explained (why not Let's Encrypt for tailnet domain?).
findings.fix_recommendation: Add section: 'Failure recovery: if health check times out, check 'docker logs vaultwarden-vaultwarden-1' and 'docker logs vaultwarden-caddy-1' for CA/cert errors.' Add: 'Manual admin password reset: POST to /admin/register with hash. Internal-CA docs: tailnet domains non-public, so ACME (Let's Encrypt) cannot verify; Caddy internal CA generates self-signed certs.'

findings.issue: meta/main.yml declares dependency on 'community.docker' collection but does NOT pin version. Line 22 lists 'community.docker' without 'version:' constraint. This risks community.docker API changes (e.g., docker_compose_v2 module signature change in future release).
findings.fix_recommendation: Change line 22 to: 'collections: [name: community.docker, version: ">=5.0.0,<6.0.0"]' (or minimum supported version). Pin to major.minor range. Add to requirements.txt/galaxy.yml in parent project: 'community.docker>=5.0.0'. Document in README: 'Tested with community.docker 5.x.'

findings.dimension_name: Tag usage — tasks tagged for selective runs
findings.issue: No tasks are tagged. Cannot selectively run 'ansible-playbook -t docker-setup' or '-t health-check' for faster iteration or debugging. All 8+ task blocks run monolithically.
findings.fix_recommendation: Add tags to logical blocks: 'tags: [docker-setup]' (lines 2-34), 'tags: [config]' (lines 47-75), 'tags: [compose-up]' (lines 110-119), 'tags: [health-check]' (lines 121-139). Document tags in README for operator convenience.

findings.dimension_name: Cross-role coupling — tight binding to base/tailscale
findings.issue: Role tightly coupled to tailscale role via implicit 'tailscale_ip' fact (line 36 in docker-compose.j2). If tailscale role is not applied or fact is missing, role fails with unclear error. No validation that tailscale_ip is set before template rendering.
findings.fix_recommendation: Add task before template rendering: 'ansible.builtin.assert: {that: [tailscale_ip is defined], fail_msg: "tailscale_ip fact not set. Ensure tailscale role is applied before vaultwarden."}' Reduces operator confusion and catches coupling issues early. Document in README that tailscale role is mandatory prerequisite.
